Passage: The electropop singer confirms plans to release her latest EP next month.
Little Boots has unveiled a new track, which will feature on her upcoming EP.
'Taste It' is the lead single on the four-track record Business Pleasure, launching on December 1.
Fans who pre-order the EP will be able to download 'Taste It' immediately.
Business Pleasure is described as "the first taste" of the electropop singer's third album, which is planned for 2015.
Little Boots - real name Victoria Hesketh - said: "For the first time, I'm in a place where I'm truly in control of my career both creatively and logistically, which is incredibly liberating and exciting."
Her previous album Nocturnes launched in 2013. It was the follow-up to her debut release Hands, which made the top five in the UK albums chart.
